sentences.en: Supplementary information includes adverbs and things that function as adverbs.
sentences.zh: 补充信息包括副词和功能相当于副词的东西。

sentences.en: You may need a supplementary dose after six months.
sentences.zh: 六个月后你可能需要额外服用一次药。

sentences.en: The teacher provided some supplementary materials to help us understand the lesson better.
sentences.zh: 老师提供了一些增补材料帮助我们更好地理解这节课。
